input.algebraic_bindings: explicit variables array with a complete matching name-to-scalar bindings map
input.algebraic_scalars: closed math text or canonical scalar envelopes only; root display text, Result envelopes and workspaces are not operands
input.compute_operands: each named argument is a canonical object envelope; explicit registry operation and all arguments including defaults; Result/workspace envelopes are not operands
input.expressions: bounded MathForge text grammar; explicit declared symbols
input.function_text: parse_function requires text and an explicit ordered variables array; symbol_ids reuse identities
input.limit_points: closed real algebraic math text or canonical scalar object envelopes, -inf or +inf
input.matrix_entries_and_bounds: matrix entries: rational strings; finite bounds: closed math text or canonical scalar object envelopes
input.multivariate_variables: explicit nonempty arrays of distinct declared symbols; order determines gradient and matrix coordinates
input.state: stateless; no filesystem or persistent workspace tools
input.symbol_identity: request-local UUIDs; pass symbol_ids to reuse identities
input.verification: canonical MathForge v1/v2/v3/v4/v5 Result envelope only
